note: Pointe Coupee Parish adopted its first zoning map and ordinance (CSRS, Aug 2025). The official zoning map is published only as a PDF (pcparish.org mdocs file 2697); the zoning districts document is also PDF. The digital zoning map is only in the Tax Assessor's GeoPortal viewer (atlas.geoportalmaps.com/ptcoupee, migrating to geosync.io); no ArcGIS REST service or downloadable zoning layer was found in searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online (LA and parish-named) or the viewer pages. Regrid zoning is a commercial parcel dataset, not official.
